mapper.select: SELECT * FROM remote_import_jobs WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM remote_import_jobs WHERE user_id=#{user} AND url_hash=#{hash}
SELECT * FROM remote_import_jobs WHERE status='queued' OR status='ingesting' OR (status='fetching' AND lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE remote_import_jobs SET status='queued',attempts=0,error_code=NULL,book_id=NULL,file_job_id=NULL,run_id=NULL,active_owner=#{user},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user} AND status='failed'

UPDATE remote_import_jobs SET status='fetching',run_id=#{run},attempts=attempts+1,lease_expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,2,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND attempts < 3 AND (status='queued' OR (status='fetching' AND lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))

UPDATE remote_import_jobs SET status='ingesting',book_id=#{book},file_job_id=#{fileJob},kind=#{kind},lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='fetching' AND run_id=#{run} AND lease_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE remote_import_jobs SET status='failed',error_code=#{code},active_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND run_id=#{run} AND status='fetching'
UPDATE remote_import_jobs SET status=#{status},error_code=#{code},active_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('ingesting','fetching')
UPDATE books SET title=CASE WHEN #{title}='' THEN title ELSE #{title} END,metadata_json=#{metadata},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{book} AND visibility!='removed'
